crash_retry_conflict_oracle: Conflict marker and read barrier persist atomically; restart retains quarantine/no-effect state.
control_or_falsifier: Falsifier: highest task_seq candidate is selected instead of conflict/quarantine.

scenario: `NEW_COVERAGE` — Revocación no bloquea consulta de historial

crash_retry_conflict_oracle: No injected crash in this test; durable replay is idempotent and does not add effects.
control_or_falsifier: Control: read-only history remains available without enabling new effects.

scenario: `NEW_COVERAGE` — Nuevo despacho tras caída y ABORT correcto
initial_state_and_preconditions: EXECUTION_1.DISPATCHED, caída antes de RUNNING
ordered_events_and_oracle: Estado inicial: EXECUTION_1.DISPATCHED, caída antes de RUNNING. Recuperación: EXECUTION_1→ABORTED (causa=CRASH_RECOVERY). Nuevo despacho: EXECUTION_2 con nuevo nonce. Oráculo: EXECUTION_2 es un despacho independiente y válido.
crash_retry_conflict_oracle: No injected crash in this test; durable replay is idempotent and does not add effects.
control_or_falsifier: Control: a new dispatch has a new execution_id and nonce; old execution stays ABORTED.

initial_state_and_preconditions: Two writers attempt an append against same task sequence head N.
ordered_events_and_oracle: One atomic append receives task_seq N+1. Concurrent stale append is rejected STALE_TASK_HEAD; it must reread the accepted head and submit a new idempotent operation. It cannot resubmit a different semantic payload under the same producer_event_id.
crash_retry_conflict_oracle: An append rejected for stale head is retried only after rereading task_seq; no event ID is reused with different payload.
control_or_falsifier: Falsifier: stale append changes task state or same producer identity is reused with different payload.

initial_state_and_preconditions: E1 bundle frozen; E1 mode planned=DRY_RUN; execution result complete; all other validators would pass.
ordered_events_and_oracle: task_seq 1 CRITERIA_FROZEN(E1); 2 DISPATCHED(E1,planned=DRY_RUN); 3 EXECUTION_STARTED(E1); 4 OUTPUT_RECEIVED(E1,COMPLETE,observed=DRY_RUN); 5 RESULT_RECORDED; 6 attempted EVALUATED(success); 7 attempted EFFECTS_COMMITTED.
crash_retry_conflict_oracle: No crash required. Duplicate event with same producer_event_id and digest remains idempotent; no effect appears after replay.
control_or_falsifier: Control: independently attested planned=observed=AUTHORIZED_REAL_EXECUTION with all other gates valid yields one adopted success and one visible contribution at most.

initial_state_and_preconditions: E1 was dispatched with authenticated turn A1 and then ABANDONED; E2 has a new dispatch turn A2 and is active in same destination session.
ordered_events_and_oracle: task_seq 1 DISPATCHED(E1,turn=A1,nonce=N1); 2 ABANDONED(E1); 3 TASK_REOPENED; 4 DISPATCHED(E2,turn=A2,nonce=N2); 5 platform-attested delayed turn A1 is offered as E2 output.
crash_retry_conflict_oracle: Re-delivery of the same rejected producer event is idempotent; it never becomes correlated later.
control_or_falsifier: Control: a platform-attested turn whose in_reply_to_turn_id exactly equals A2 and whose session/nonce/captor all match can proceed.

initial_state_and_preconditions: One valid contribution C1 is visible for (destination X,result_lineage R1,kind K); evaluation E1 is current for R1.
ordered_events_and_oracle: task_seq 1 EVALUATION_REVISED(E2,supersedes=E1,result_lineage=R1); 2 EFFECT_PLAN_PREPARED(retract C1/apply C2); 3 crash injected before publication; 4 recovery; 5 commit replacement.
crash_retry_conflict_oracle: Recovery resumes the same plan idempotently or voids it if guards fail; it cannot expose both C1 and C2.
control_or_falsifier: Control: if E2 is ineligible, plan is VOIDED and C1 remains only if its source is still valid and not invalidated; no unguarded successor appears.

initial_state_and_preconditions: current_evaluation_id_by_result=E1; current_task_evaluation_id=E1; projection_generation=7; E2 is independently validated as an eligible successor under the frozen selection policy.
ordered_events_and_oracle: task_seq 1 EVALUATION_REVISED(E2,supersedes=E1); 2 atomic pointer CAS/transition; 3 reader snapshots before and after the transaction.
crash_retry_conflict_oracle: Crash before transaction leaves E1 current and E2 unadopted; crash after commit leaves E2 current or null according to the committed decision; replay converges to same generation/state.
control_or_falsifier: Control: valid E2 with matching frozen policy becomes pointer atomically; a stale writer using old projection_generation is rejected.

initial_state_and_preconditions: E1 dispatch references bundle B1: criteria D1, check set K1, validation policy V1, canonicalization C1.

crash_retry_conflict_oracle: Retry with identical mismatched digests remains rejected. A new bundle requires a new dispatch.
control_or_falsifier: Control: used digest set (D1,K1,V1,C1) exactly matching B1 may validate, provided attested checks actually executed and all other gates pass.

initial_state_and_preconditions: Execution E1 dispatched at trusted store time t0; frozen timeout is 600 seconds; abandon_deadline_at=t0+600s.
ordered_events_and_oracle: Case A: ABANDONED accepted_at=t0+599s. Case B: ABANDONED accepted_at=t0+600s. Case C: trusted clock unavailable.

control_or_falsifier: Control: after deadline with trusted clock and eligible in-flight state, ABANDONED is accepted exactly once.

initial_state_and_preconditions: Same task/result lineage R1 and same frozen bundle B1; two authorized validators submit different canonical evaluation payloads E1/E2 that both claim the same used digests.

crash_retry_conflict_oracle: Conflict barrier and durable recovery work are recorded atomically; recovery from either order produces the same blocked state.
control_or_falsifier: Control: byte-identical canonical payload under same evaluation identity is reused idempotently, not a conflict.

initial_state_and_preconditions: Plan P prepared under authorization_generation=7 with C1 staged invisible; current projection_generation is fixed.
ordered_events_and_oracle: task_seq 1 EFFECT_PLAN_PREPARED(P,auth_gen=7); 2 AUTHORIZATION_REVOKED advances auth generation to 8; 3 attempted EFFECTS_COMMITTED(P,expected_auth_gen=7).
crash_retry_conflict_oracle: A crash after revocation but before cleanup cannot expose C1 because the plan is invisible and voiding obligation is durable in the revocation transaction.

initial_state_and_preconditions: Valid manual attachment A1 and E_MANUAL exist only in lane MANUAL; AUTO task pointer points to null or separate eligible automatic evaluation.
ordered_events_and_oracle: task_seq 1 ATTACHED(A1,lane=MANUAL); 2 EVALUATED(E_MANUAL,lane=MANUAL); 3 attempted PROJECTION_ADOPTED(E_MANUAL,lane=AUTO); 4 attempted AUTO EFFECTS_COMMITTED sourced from E_MANUAL.
crash_retry_conflict_oracle: Replay does not promote the manual event; no direct conversion operation exists.
control_or_falsifier: Control: a new authorized real execution with new dispatch/result/evaluation IDs may be independently eligible.

initial_state_and_preconditions: E1 and contribution C1 belong to result_lineage R1; C1 was active before a conflict. R1 is read-blocked and C1 is invisible/retraction-pending.
ordered_events_and_oracle: task_seq 1 CONFLICT_DETECTED(CF1) atomically blocks R1 and persists retraction; 2 CONFLICT_RESOLVED(CF1,independent reviewer, evidence); 3 EVALUATED(E3,restores_event_id=CF1,supersedes_evaluation_id=E1,result_lineage=R1); 4 new effect plan with contribution C3 (new ID) prepared; 5 commit after all guards pass.
crash_retry_conflict_oracle: Crash at any step retains barrier until conflict resolution and replacement plan recover; no reader sees C1 while blocked or both C1/C3.
control_or_falsifier: Control: if independent resolution evidence is absent or E3 digest/criteria differ, R1 remains blocked and C3 cannot commit.

initial_state_and_preconditions: Frozen bundle plans AUTHORIZED_REAL_EXECUTION; route registered and other data valid; observed mode attestation says DRY_RUN.
ordered_events_and_oracle: task_seq 1 CRITERIA_FROZEN(B1); 2 DISPATCHED(E1,planned=AUTHORIZED_REAL_EXECUTION); 3 EXECUTION_STARTED; 4 OUTPUT_RECEIVED(complete,observed=DRY_RUN,attestation=M1); 5 validation attempts success.

control_or_falsifier: New execution with planned=observed=AUTHORIZED_REAL_EXECUTION, independent attestation and all gates valid can produce exactly one current task success and one active contribution.

initial_state_and_preconditions: Subcase A: execution_path_id is absent/unregistered. Subcase B: route is valid but observed-mode attestation is missing.

initial_state_and_preconditions: Profile NO_RESULT, or sandbox diagnostic occurs without accepted EXECUTION_STARTED and real terminal output.

crash_retry_conflict_oracle: Repeated omission is rejected; a valid later event with stable identity can claim the slot once.

initial_state_and_preconditions: Two distinct tasks have complete independently eligible results with identical canonical output bytes/digest and separate event identities.

crash_retry_conflict_oracle: Replay each task/event is individually idempotent; cross-task digest reuse does not collapse either record.
control_or_falsifier: Within one task/execution/lane, same producer_event_id and digest replay creates no additional result/effect.
